newsitem.title: GERMANY: Bonn, post office sell DSK to Bankgesellschaft.
newsitem.headline: Bonn, post office sell DSK to Bankgesellschaft.

text.p: Germany's federal government and the national post office announced on Tuesday they had sold town planning agency Deutsche Stadtentwicklungs-gesellschaft (DSK) to a unit of Bankgesellschaft Berlin.

The sale completes the privatisation of the former state building company Deutschbau, from which DSK had earlier been unbundled. Deutschbau was sold in May for two billion marks to the property development units of utility Veba AG and Deutsche Bank AG.

Neither the Finance Ministry, which owned 58 percent of DSK, nor the Post Office, with 41 percent, commented on the sale price. The remaining one percent still belongs to the Deutsche Bau- und Bodenbank.

The Finance Ministry said DSK was a leading service company in the town planning business, and was responsible for the redevelopment of the new parliament and government district now under construction in Berlin.
DSK is one of over 400 government holdings whose status Bonn is reviewing with a view to possible privatisation.
